answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 50 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a reef bet on surviving 50 epochs of grading, and every wharf settlement recomputes the terrace schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
